verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an inference API platform. A built-in assistant in its console or docs is a plausible capability, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a console Playground for experimenting with models and a chat trial demo. These are model-testing surfaces, not an assistant you delegate product tasks to, and nothing documents an in-product agent that acts on projects, keys, usage or endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
